_readme: Liquipedia, as the schedule's source of start times (pipeline/liquipedia_schedule.py,
.github/workflows/liquipedia.yml). Liquipedia is the community wiki every OWCS
fan already uses for brackets; its match pages carry the start time and time
zone of every series, the teams of slots the spreadsheet still reads TBD, and
the stream. Its text is CC BY-SA 3.0: the Matches page credits it and links
back to the page each match came from.
Liquipedia's API terms (https://liquipedia.net/api-terms-of-use), all kept:
* a User-Agent naming this project and where to reach it;
* gzip;
* at most one request every 2 seconds (`minIntervalSeconds`), and never
action=parse (rate-limited to one per 30 s) — page text is read with
action=query&prop=revisions, up to 50 pages per request;
* once a day, plus on demand; only pages under `prefixes`.
A page title maps to one of the schedule's event keys (the sheet_schedule.json
keys): first by the `events` rules below (the first regex that matches wins),
otherwise by reading the title itself — a regional word (North America/NA,
EMEA, Korea, Japan, China, Pacific) plus 'Stage N' is that region's stage, and
'Asia' with no regional word is the Asia championship. A page that maps to
nothing is skipped and listed in the run log, so a renamed Liquipedia page
shows up as an unmapped title instead of silently dropping a stage. Pages
matching `skip` (qualifiers, opens, statistics) are never read.
